name: nintendo-best-selling-games-top-five

angle.hook: Wii Sports, 82.79 million, still leads Nintendo's sales pages ahead of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
angle.why_now: evergreen: Switch pages as of 30 Sep 2026
angle.players_here: Wii Sports, Mario Kart and Animal Crossing are what many readers grew up on
angle.payoff: two Mario Kart games in the top five, and Mario Kart World already at 16.48 million on Switch 2

reel_check.SOURCE primary read in full: yes: Nintendo IR software pages (Switch, Switch 2, Wii, DS, 3DS, Wii U) read 8 Nov 2026 about 08:30Z; as-of dates 30 Sep 2026 (Switch, Switch 2), 30 Sep 2016 (Wii, DS), 31 Dec 2016 (3DS, Wii U); evergreen
reel_check.SOURCE not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded (0 hits); different from the 17 Oct consoles Reel and from the 8 Nov hardware top five; no Mario Kart or Wii Sports post in the story files of the last week
reel_check.SOURCE older than 24h: n/a: evergreen; dated by Nintendo's next Switch page update (early Feb 2027)
reel_check.TYPE NUMBERS: yes: figure per game, period life-to-date as of the dates above, source Nintendo IR, comparison = bars against the leader and Mario Kart World's 16.48M on the closing line
reel_check.STORY one spoken paragraph: yes: 'تبدأ القائمة بلعبة سباقات على Wii. لعبتا Mario Kart ضمن أول خمس ألعاب. أما Mario Kart World على Switch 2 فبلغت 16.48 مليونًا.' read aloud
reel_check.STORY names match names-ar.md: yes: نينتيندو (Nintendo) bracketed at first mention in the headline; game and platform names in Latin as Nintendo writes them (a colon in a long title breaks the line and is dropped on screen only)
reel_check.POST Arabic grammar and direction: yes: every line and caption paragraph opens on an Arabic word; Western digits; no sign after a Latin name
reel_check.POST source comment: yes: pages, as-of dates and Nintendo's 'consolidated sales' wording, link on X only
reel_check.SOUND: yes: our bed, stats flavour (graphics and a still, no footage sound); no effects over footage
reel_check.PICTURE footage first: n/a: numbers evergreen on Nintendo's package images; no single official clip covers the five games; the closing beat is an official game image, not a card
reel_check.PICTURE not same picture as last 5 Reels: yes: Wii Sports, Switch package art and Mario Kart World store art; the last Reels are other games
reel_check.PICTURE one visual requirement per beat,: yes: one package per row, whole at 1x or smaller; hero Wii Sports enlarged 1.6x at most from Nintendo's 150x120 image; closing still 1920x1080 cropped to 9:16 at 1.78x, Mario and Luigi kept in frame
reel_check.PICTURE headline in band, no blur: yes: headline in the top band; no blurred fill
